admission.justification: A recursive listing can erase an empty directory entry and turn malformed declared input into silent absence. Exact raw entry-mode custody preserves the refusal rather than certifying a candidate the parser never received.

applicability: Candidate-tree observation of generated-copies.json before regular-file blob lookup and projection parsing.
conditions: Presence is determined by a bounded exact nonrecursive tree-entry observation, not by recursive leaf inventory alone.
An existing empty tree, including a tree containing only empty subtrees, remains a present nonregular declaration and refuses by its declaration path.
Only regular-file entry modes proceed to the existing declaration blob lookup/parser; a truly absent entry retains absence semantics.
A tree-entry read failure is a named code-read failure, not a fabricated absent declaration.
exclusions: No empty-tree declaration is accepted or recursively read to invent a regular payload.
The historical two native-Git regression passes remain producer evidence; this publication runs neither Git fixture tests nor generated-copy synchronization.
statement: Generated-copy declaration presence comes from the raw candidate entry, so a present empty tree or tree of empty subtrees is named incomplete rather than absent.
